versions.content: {DRAFT} If • configuration parameter EthTSynRateRatioEnable is set to TRUE • and a valid neighborRateRatio has been calculated (refer to [SWS_EthTSyn_00263]) • and a new valid Follow-Up message has been received, then EthTSyn shall calculate in the next main function the rateRatio as given in PRS_TS_00261 in [1].
